meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: Claude 会当你的写作搭档:帮你把想法搭成大纲、查资料并加引用、改写开头 Hook、写完一节给一节反馈,同时尽量保留你原本的语气。
howto.when: 当你写博客、深度文章或技术文档,想找人帮你搭大纲、查资料加引用、改 Hook 或逐段评审时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这篇关于「主题」的文章搭一个大纲
say.note: 它会先问受众、篇幅和写作目的再给结构

say.text: 这是我的开头,帮我把 Hook 改得更有吸引力
say.note: 会给出几个备选开头并说明各自理由

say.text: 我刚写完「为什么重要」这一节,帮我看看并给反馈
say.note: 会列出做得好的地方和具体修改建议

howto.what_en: Claude acts as your writing partner: it builds outlines, finds sources and adds citations, rewrites your hook, and gives feedback section by section while keeping your voice.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, articles, or technical docs and you want help outlining, researching citations, fixing the hook, or reviewing each section.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about [topic]
say_en.note: It asks about audience, length, and goal first

say_en.text: Here's my intro. Help me make the hook more compelling.
say_en.note: It offers several alternative openings with reasons

say_en.text: I finished the 'Why This Matters' section. Review it.
say_en.note: You get strengths plus specific line-level fixes
